scenario: Trailing underscore in an integer literal, per [LLEX.11.1]: `42_` is invalid. `DEC_LIT ::= DIGIT ('_'? DIGIT)*` ends on a digit, so the trailing `_` is one the production does not admit, and no unit suffix follows it ([LLEX.12.1]); the lexer refuses it.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    S s where s.v == 42_
->
    log info "x"
